description.p: MouseKit remaps the buttons of your mouse and switches between sets of bindings automatically as you move between applications, so the same button can do one thing in a game and another in your browser.

ul.li: Bind any mouse button or scroll direction to a key, a shortcut, another mouse button, or a macro
Profiles that activate when a chosen application has focus (KDE Plasma on Wayland)
Record macros from the keyboard and play them once, while held, or as a toggle
Set DPI and report rate on supported Logitech mice
Works in games running through Proton
